HK51B.description: Aftermarket carbine conversion of the MG80 heavy LMG. Fires at an extreme rate of speed from a 100 round box, but has awful recoil. Has a lengthy reload process.
HK51B.name: HK51B

K1A.description: A Seongho Carbine stemming from the prototype XK1 rifle. Much like the K2 this rifle is quite balanced but leans more into CQC power.
K1A.name: K1A

SCAR SC.description:
The MK16 SOCOM SC is a sub-compact carbine based on the MK16 SOCOM with a 9in barrel firing the .300 Blackout cartridge. The gun is currently in service with some European police forces.

Relatively high damage and good handling, but held back somewhat by a low rate of fire.

Model submitted by Mysterious Modeler X.
SCAR SC.name: SCAR SC

MC51SD.description: Developed for the Soveran special forces. Features battle rifle damage characteristics with mild recoil, slow fire rate, and a smaller magazine than average.
MC51SD.name: MC51SD

SR-3M.description: A Zarovian carbine chambered in 9x39mm, designed for police use. Exceptional close quarters performance, featuring a very high rate of fire with low recoil, but has a smaller magazine.
SR-3M.name: SR-3M

AK105.description: A modernized AK74 rifle with a carbine barrel. Slow firerate with high close-range damage and moderate muzzle velocity.
AK105.name: AK105

JURY.description: A carbine variant of the Selvazian-made Judge revolver. High damage and firerate with harsh recoil and reduced magazine capacity.
JURY.name: JURY

CAR-15.description:
An early development of an AR-15 carbine from the 1960s, featuring an early-pattern 30 round magazine and an oversized flash hider.

Like the M16A1, it possesses a relatively high rate of fire.


Not for use by a senator's son.
CAR-15.name: CAR-15

attachmentModifiers.info:
Load your GAU-5A/A with green-tipped M855 5.56x45mm ammo.

Later used due to being more favourable than M193, M855 has much greater penetration potential than the M193.

However M855 has erratic performance when fired in the GAU-5A/A as bullets tumble in the air.

M4.description:
A Grand Federation carbine based on the AR-15 platform. Burst fire trigger group. Very stable firing characteristics with a high rate of fire. Compared to the M4A1, it has slightly higher damage.

Model submitted by Rialag.
M4.name: M4

C25.description:
An upgraded variant of the C8A4 CMAR rifle which entered service in 2025. Possesses a monolithic upper receiver design that maximizes usable rail space, and generally improved ergonomics over the earlier C8A2 and M4A1 rifles.

Model submitted by Rialag.
C25.name: C25

L22.description:
A small carbine variant as part of the SA80 family!
The L22A2 is outfitted with a vertical front grip instead of a handguard. Around 1500 were manufactured from surplus L86 LSWs and another 500 were built from increased demand.
Increased fire rate while keeping ranged damage high, but the short barrel worsens accuracy and recoil, but also reduces the weight.

Model submitted by Mysterious Modeler X.
L22.name: L22

AK12C.description:
A variant of the pre-production AK-12 chambered in the uncommon 9x39mm ammunition. Intended as a continuation of the AK-9 development, previous prototypes of this rifle were based on the AKS-74U and later the AK-104. Ultimately, it was shelved along with the rest of the pre-production AK-12s.

High damaging especially in close range, but held back by a relatively below average magazine capacity.

Model submitted by Rialag
AK12C.name: AK12C
